name: Hourly Sales
query:
SELECT
    time_intervals.`Time Interval`,
    COALESCE(SUM(sales_by_interval.`Sales`), 0) AS 'Sales',
    COUNT(sales_by_interval.`Bill`) AS 'Bills'
FROM (
    SELECT '12 AM - 01 AM' AS 'Time Interval', 1 AS 'Order'
    UNION ALL SELECT '01 AM - 02 AM', 2  UNION ALL SELECT '02 AM - 03 AM', 3
    UNION ALL SELECT '03 AM - 04 AM', 4  UNION ALL SELECT '04 AM - 05 AM', 5
    UNION ALL SELECT '05 AM - 06 AM', 6  UNION ALL SELECT '06 AM - 07 AM', 7
    UNION ALL SELECT '07 AM - 08 AM', 8  UNION ALL SELECT '08 AM - 09 AM', 9
    UNION ALL SELECT '09 AM - 10 AM', 10 UNION ALL SELECT '10 AM - 11 AM', 11
    UNION ALL SELECT '11 AM - 12 PM', 12 UNION ALL SELECT '12 PM - 01 PM', 13
    UNION ALL SELECT '01 PM - 02 PM', 14 UNION ALL SELECT '02 PM - 03 PM', 15
    UNION ALL SELECT '03 PM - 04 PM', 16 UNION ALL SELECT '04 PM - 05 PM', 17
    UNION ALL SELECT '05 PM - 06 PM', 18 UNION ALL SELECT '06 PM - 07 PM', 19
    UNION ALL SELECT '07 PM - 08 PM', 20 UNION ALL SELECT '08 PM - 09 PM', 21
    UNION ALL SELECT '09 PM - 10 PM', 22 UNION ALL SELECT '10 PM - 11 PM', 23
    UNION ALL SELECT '11 PM - 12 AM', 24
) AS time_intervals
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 0 THEN '12 AM - 01 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 1 THEN '01 AM - 02 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 2 THEN '02 AM - 03 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 3 THEN '03 AM - 04 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 4 THEN '04 AM - 05 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 5 THEN '05 AM - 06 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 6 THEN '06 AM - 07 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 7 THEN '07 AM - 08 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 8 THEN '08 AM - 09 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 9 THEN '09 AM - 10 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 10 THEN '10 AM - 11 AM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 11 THEN '11 AM - 12 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 12 THEN '12 PM - 01 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 13 THEN '01 PM - 02 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 14 THEN '02 PM - 03 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 15 THEN '03 PM - 04 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 16 THEN '04 PM - 05 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 17 THEN '05 PM - 06 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 18 THEN '06 PM - 07 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 19 THEN '07 PM - 08 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 20 THEN '08 PM - 09 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 21 THEN '09 PM - 10 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 22 THEN '10 PM - 11 PM'
            WHEN HOUR(`creation`) = 23 THEN '11 PM - 12 AM'
        END AS 'Time Interval',
        `name` AS "Bill",
        `grand_total` AS 'Sales'
    FROM `tabPOS Invoice`
    WHERE 
        DATE(`creation`) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
        AND `branch` = %(branch)s
        AND `docstatus` = 1
        AND `status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid")
) AS sales_by_interval
ON time_intervals.`Time Interval` = sales_by_interval.`Time Interval`
GROUP BY time_intervals.`Time Interval`
ORDER BY time_intervals.`Order`;
